ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Code Execute via Winrm.vbs
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects an attempt to execute code or create service on remote host via winrm.vbs.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "cscript\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*winrm.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*invoke\\ Create\\ wmicimv2\\/Win32\\_.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-r\\:http.*")))
